name: AgroHub
blurb: where farmer cooperatives in Nigeria sell together and get paid on delivery
tagline: farmer cooperatives sell together and get paid on delivery
summary: A phone-first platform where Nigerian farmer cooperatives sell members' harvests to bulk buyers. Buyers pay upfront and the money is held until delivery is confirmed, then split automatically between the cooperative and each farmer. It has roles for farmer, officer, buyer, admin and board, and supports English first, with Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba and Igbo planned.

cover.alt: AgroHub landing page: Sell together. Get paid on delivery.

story: AgroHub is a phone-first platform where farmer cooperatives in Nigeria sell their members’ harvests to bulk buyers. A cooperative lists a lot, a buyer pays for it upfront, and nobody has to trust anybody on a handshake.
The money is held until the buyer confirms delivery. Then it is split automatically: the cooperative’s share, and each farmer’s share of the lot they contributed to.
I’m building it alone, end to end: product, design, the Next.js app, the database, payments and the tests. It is in progress, with English first and Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba and Igbo planned.

chapters.title: Selling together
chapters.text: One farmer with a few bags has little pull with a bulk buyer. A cooperative with a full lot does. Buyers browse open lots by crop, size and location, and each lot shows exactly which members it came from.

images.alt: AgroHub public catalogue of harvest lots available to buyers

chapters.title: Paid on delivery
chapters.text: Buyers pay through Paystack when they commit. AgroHub holds the money until delivery is confirmed, then splits it between the cooperative and each farmer, so the person who grew the crop sees their share without chasing anyone.

images.alt: AgroHub price board showing weekly crop prices

chapters.title: Built for phones
chapters.text: Most farmers and officers will only ever open AgroHub on a phone, often on a slow connection. Every screen is designed small first, with large tap targets and very little to download.

images.alt: AgroHub landing page at phone width
AgroHub lot catalogue at phone width

chapters.title: Five roles, one app
chapters.text: Farmers, cooperative officers, buyers, admins and the board each see a different AgroHub. Sign-in uses better-auth with two-factor for anyone who handles money, and every role is covered by Vitest and Playwright tests.
